source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026, cover page
source.quote: The number of shares of common stock, $0.001 par value, outstanding as of August 21, 2026, was 24.1 billion.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as NVDA. The latest 10-Q cover (quarter ended July 26, 2026; no later 10-Q was on EDGAR at the time of research) states the count only rounded to 24.1 billion, so the share count carries up to about ±0.2% rounding. The precise count in the 2026 proxy was 24,312,141,810 at March 23, 2026; it is older and was reduced by buybacks since.
